title: Task fMRI — SPM25 First-Level (Auditory) + FSL FEAT replication
description: Single-subject task-fMRI reproduction of the classic SPM auditory block-design analysis in SPM25 and FSL FEAT, including preprocessing, motion nuisance modeling, Listening versus Rest first-level contrasts, corrected statistical inference, quality control, activation maps, peak and cluster reporting, and cross-software comparison.
